INTERNXT_REMOTE_NAME.description: rclone remote name pointing at your Internxt (or any other rclone-compatible) account, as configured via `rclone config`. Not a secret — it's a label, not a token. Scripts default to 'myremote' when unset.

BACKUP_BUCKET_PREFIX.description: Top-level folder/bucket prefix within the remote where backups are stored (e.g. 'backups'). Scripts default to 'backups' when unset.

BACKUP_SOURCE_DIR.description: Directory (relative to repo root, or absolute) that internxt-mind-delta.sh / internxt-mind-full.sh watch and snapshot. Scripts default to 'backup-source' when unset.

AGE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT.description: macOS Keychain account name under which your age private key is stored. Used by internxt-restore.sh and rotate-age-key.cjs to look the key up with `security find-generic-password`. Defaults to 'backup-tool'. Seed it with tools/boot/keychain-store.sh.

AGE_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE.description: macOS Keychain service name under which your age private key is stored. Defaults to 'backup-age-key-v2'. Seed it with tools/boot/keychain-store.sh.
